svg.title: 2015 SI Q129: four Venn diagram choices
svg.desc: A shows three circular sets in a chain with overlaps; B shows two intersecting circles enclosed by a larger outer circle; C shows two intersecting circles only; D shows two overlapping circles and a long horizontal rounded capsule through their overlap.
svg.text: Choice diagrams are traced illustrations from the 2015 Open Candidates coaching-archive scan, page 16
